title: WebForge Component Metadata
description: Sidecar metadata (meta.json) describing a single component in the library. Lives next to the component's .tsx implementation.

style.description: Design styles this component fits, matches designSystem.style values, can support multiple

industry.description: Industries/site types this suits best, empty/['*'] = universal

entry.description: Relative path to the .tsx file from the component's own folder

requires.description: npm package names this component needs beyond the base stack

dependsOnComponents.description: Other component ids this one imports/composes (e.g. a pricing table using a Badge atom)

props.description: JSON-schema-like description of the props/content this component accepts, used to map spec 'content' onto real props

weight.description: Base score multiplier used as a tie-breaker in matching (higher = preferred when scores are otherwise equal)
